diagnosis: All four rollouts revealed both PF1 and PF2 and cited them in justification_fact_ids, so disclosure was never the problem. The gate failed solely on check C4, which failed in rollouts 1 and 2. In those two rollouts, PF2 was revealed by A3 and cited as justification, but the model encoded the ICU-2 backup information as a documentation/follow-up commitment targeting the person "Ravi" (e.g., "Ravi will add the engineering confirmation for ICU-2's battery inspection to the shared equipment log today") rather than as a coverage-plan entry targeting "ICU" with the 21:00-01:00 availability window. In the two passing rollouts (0 and 3), the model produced a coverage_plan_record/coverage_plan_entry with target "ICU" and detail mentioning "ICU-2 available 21:00-01:00." This is an ENCODING MISMATCH: C4's expected field or format does not match how the model naturally records the ICU backup plan when it frames the outcome as a documentation task rather than a coverage-plan record.

C4.why: The confirmed ICU-2 availability changes the ICU coverage plan from unspecified backup coverage to ICU-2 specifically from 21:00 to 01:00.
